response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded, with genuine high-throughput experience at Sociomantic/dunnhumby and a strong craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 growth-and-experimentation specialist, and the resume shows no experimentation platform, feature-flagging, A/B testing, bias detection, or telemetry/metrics infrastructure work, and no evidence of statistical or measurement-driven decision systems. Titles top out at Senior/Staff in small-to-mid companies, with little demonstrated multi-workstream, cross-org influence at enterprise scale. Core language and systems fundamentals align (JS/TS, C/C++, Java, C#), and the AI-agent tooling work at re:cinq is a modest plus, so a screening conversation could be warranted if the pipeline is thin — but the domain gap for this specific charter is large.
strengths: 15+ years hands-on across many stacks; meets language and tenure bar
Real high-scale, low-latency service experience (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering-quality culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, mentoring/teaching
concerns: No experimentation, feature-flighting, or A/B/measurement platform experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical data analysis
Scope and title trajectory below Principal/IC6 enterprise cross-org leadership

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of engineering experience
Principal-level scope and cross-team influence not demonstrated
